description:
This is not a solicitation/request for proposal. The solicitation/request for proposal will be forth coming. When issued the Solicitation/Request for Proposal can be found on the DSCC Bid website at http://dibbs.dscc.dla.mil/rfp/.

The subject requirement is for the acquisition of NSN 2590-01-598-7777 (Cover, Vehicular Components). This will be solicited as an Indefinite Quantity Long Term Contract containing a 3-year base period and 2 (1) year options. The total duration, base plus option years, shall not exceed 5 years. Items will be shipped to various stocking locations within the continental United States. Various incremental quantities will be solicited. While price is a significant factor in the evaluation of offers, the final award decision will be based upon a combination of price, delivery, past performance and other evaluation factors as described in the solicitation.

ANY AVAILABLE DRAWINGS CAN BE DOWNLOADED BY AUTHORIZED USERS FROM THE CFOLDERS WEBSITE https://pcf1x.bsm.dla.mil/ cfolders. OFFERORS ARE ASKED TO REFERENCE MR015987777 IN CFOLDERS.

Please submit attached Market Research forms with intended interest.
